newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures ease on sterling strength.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures ease on sterling strength.

text.p: LIFFE grain futures eased on the strength of sterling, traders said.
But the market was well underpinned by shipper interest in particular, which meant that the effect of currency moves was muted.
"If you look where sterling is, it should be a lot easier," one trader said.
There had been no change in the fundamental state of the market, he said.

Trade in wheat was concentrated on the old crop months, with July most active. July last traded 0.40 stg lower at 104.00 stg. July volume was 259 lots of a total 616. Much of the rest, a further 242 lots, were on May.
On barley November dominated, with 60 of a total 68 lots. November last changed hands 0.50 stg lower at 94.75 stg.
